exhibition.title: Damascus International Fair 2026
exhibition.description: The Damascus International Fair is the oldest and most prominent multi-sector economic event in the Middle East. Returning for its 63rd edition, this premier commercial exhibition serves as a strategic platform for reconstruction, trade, and economic partnerships. Bringing together nearly 1,000 exhibiting entities from 60 countries, the event spans diverse sectors including construction, technology, agriculture, and energy at the Damascus Fairgrounds.
